 <div class="hotel-landing__info">
 <div class="hotel-landing__stars-row">
 <div class="stars_icons">

 <h1 class="hotel-landing__name">Kilombo Villas</h1>
 <div class="hotel-landing__address">
 <img src="https://book.omnibees.com/icons/location_map_icon.svg" alt="location">
 <span>Rua das Tartarugas, 1 Praia de Sibauma, Tibau Do Sul 59178-000</span>
 <a class="hotel-landing__map-link location_maps" data-bs-toggle="modal" data-bs-target="#hotel_map">
 See on Map </a>
 </div>
 <div class="hotel-landing__description">
 Live relaxing days in contact with nature on the beach on the paradisiacal beach of Sibaúma.
Kilombo Villas is a luxury hotel, located in the Northeast of Brazil, on the paradisiacal beach of Sibaúma. No Kilombo or true luxury is a connection with nature with the total exclusivity, delicacy and experience that the hotel provides to its guests.
The experiences lived at Kilombo Villas create a unique atmosphere to love everything around you and live in every present moment. The Kilombo has 10 exclusive accommodations of unique personalities, from minimalist to brutalist architecture, in total integration with the paradisiacal Sibaúma beach.
We are in the Northeast of Brazil, in the City of Tibau do Sul/ RN, 10 minutes from the beach of Pipa Beach. We are a part of Sibaúma, we seek privacy, we avoid crowds and we want our guests to integrate into our paradise, to understand it, live it and appreciate it in a unique way and thus discover our secrets.
 </div>
 </div>
